mapper.sql: we.id, we.workation_id, we.transaction_id, we.expense_category_id, we.card_id, we.budget_type, we.amount, we.merchant_name, we.spent_at AS spent_date, we.memo, we.is_auto_categorized, we.created_at, we.updated_at, ec.name AS category_name, ec.description AS category_description, ucl.custom_name, c.card_name, c.card_number, c.card_type, t.merchant_id, m.category AS merchant_category

FROM workation_expenses we JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id = we.expense_category_id LEFT JOIN user_category_labels ucl ON ucl.expense_category_id = ec.id AND ucl.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.id = we.card_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.id = we.transaction_id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = t.merchant_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_auto_categorized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unchecked_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN budget_type = 'WORK' AND transaction_id IS NULL AND (card_id IS NULL OR merchant_name IS NULL OR merchant_name = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS unproofed_count FROM workation_expenses WHERE workation_id = #{workationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workation_expenses (workation_id, transaction_id, expense_category_id, card_id, budget_type, amount, merchant_name, spent_at, memo, is_auto_categorized) VALUES (#{workationId}, #{transactionId}, #{expenseCategoryId}, #{cardId}, #{budgetType}, #{amount}, #{merchantName}, #{spentDate}, #{memo}, #{isAutoCategorized})
mapper.update: UPDATE workation_expenses SET merchant_name = #{merchantName}, card_id = #{cardId}, amount = #{amount}, spent_at = #{spentDate}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{expenseId}
UPDATE workation_expenses SET expense_category_id = #{expenseCategoryId}, is_auto_categorized = 0 WHERE id = #{expenseId}
UPDATE workation_expenses SET budget_type = #{budgetType}, expense_category_id = #{expenseCategoryId}, is_auto_categorized = 0 WHERE id = #{expenseId}
mapper.select:
SELECT #{workationId} AS workation_id, tx.transaction_id, tx.card_id, tx.amount, tx.merchant_name, tx.spent_date, tx.budget_type, COALESCE( CASE WHEN bud_ucr.id IS NOT NULL THEN ucr.expense_category_id END, CASE WHEN bud_mcm.id IS NOT NULL THEN mcm.expense_category_id END, etc.id ) AS expense_category_id, 1 AS is_auto_categorized FROM ( SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, t.card_id, t.merchant_id, t.amount, t.merchant_name, DATE(t.approved_at) AS spent_date, CASE WHEN c.card_type = 'WORK' THEN 'WORK' ELSE 'PERSONAL' END AS budget_type FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'PAID' AND t.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND t.approved_at >= #{startDate} AND t.approved_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workation_expenses we WHERE we.transaction_id = t.id ) ) tx LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = tx.merchant_id LEFT JOIN user_category_rules ucr ON ucr.merchant_id = m.id AND ucr.user_id = #{userId} AND ucr.budget_type = tx.budget_type
LEFT JOIN merchant_category_mappings mcm ON mcm.merchant_category = m.category COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND mcm.budget_type = tx.budget_type LEFT JOIN budgets bud_ucr ON bud_ucr.workation_id = #{workationId} AND bud_ucr.budget_type = tx.budget_type AND bud_ucr.expense_category_id = ucr.expense_category_id LEFT JOIN budgets bud_mcm ON bud_mcm.workation_id = #{workationId} AND bud_mcm.budget_type = tx.budget_type AND bud_mcm.expense_category_id = mcm.expense_category_id JOIN expense_categories etc ON etc.budget_type = tx.budget_type AND etc.code = 'ETC' AND etc.user_id IS NULL
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO workation_expenses (workation_id, transaction_id, expense_category_id, card_id, budget_type, amount, merchant_name, spent_at, is_auto_categorized) VALUES
(#{item.workationId}, #{item.transactionId}, #{item.expenseCategoryId}, #{item.cardId}, #{item.budgetType}, #{item.amount}, #{item.merchantName}, #{item.spentDate}, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transaction_id = VALUES(transaction_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM expense_categories WHERE budget_type = #{budgetType} AND code = 'ETC' AND user_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_category_rules (user_id, merchant_id, expense_category_id, budget_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{expenseCategoryId}, #{budgetType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expense_category_id = #{expenseCategoryId}, updated_at = NOW()
